ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The circuit in the figure has three inputs A, B, C and one output Z. A is directly connected to the upper input of an AND gate; B first passes through an inverter, and the inverter output is connected to the lower input of that AND gate; the AND gate output is connected to one input of the XOR gate on the right; C is directly connected to the other input of the XOR gate; the XOR gate output is Z. All gate delays are 20 ns. Reasoning: Let the inverter output be X = NOT B, the AND gate output be Y = A AND X, and finally Z = Y XOR C. When t < 0, A=0, B=1, C=0, so X=0, Y=0, Z=0 XOR 0=0. At t=0, A and C become 1, and B becomes 0. The change of C directly reaches the XOR input, so after the XOR gate delay of 20 ns, Z becomes 1 at t=20 ns, at which time Y is still 0. The change of B first passes through the inverter, so X becomes 1 at t=20 ns; at this time A is already 1, so the AND gate output Y, after another 20 ns, becomes 1 at t=40 ns. The change of Y then passes through the XOR gate delay of 20 ns, causing Z to change back to 0 at t=60 ns, because after this Y=1 and C=1, and the XOR output is 0. Therefore Z is 1 from t=20 ns to t=60 ns, and the duration is 60-20=40 ns.

method.method_draft: Name the inverter output X = NOT B and the AND output Y = A AND X. From the text, before t=0: A=0, B=1, C=0, so X=0, Y=0, and Z=Y XOR C=0. At t=0, A and C rise to 1 while B falls to 0. The C change reaches the XOR output after one gate delay, making Z respond at t=20 ns while Y is still 0. The B change reaches X at t=20 ns; then with A already 1, the AND output Y changes to 1 after another 20 ns, at t=40 ns. This Y change reaches the XOR output after the final XOR delay at t=60 ns, returning Z to 0 because Y and C are then both 1. Therefore Z is high from 20 ns to 60 ns, for 40 ns.

图像描述：图中电路有三个输入 A、B、C 和一个输出 Z。A 直接接到一个 AND 门的上输入；B 先经过一个反相器，反相器输出接到该 AND 门的下输入；AND 门输出接到右侧 XOR 门的一个输入；C 直接接到 XOR 门的另一个输入；XOR 门输出为 Z。所有门延迟均为 20 ns。

推理：令反相器输出为 X = NOT B，AND 门输出为 Y = A AND X，最终 Z = Y XOR C。t < 0 时，A=0、B=1、C=0，所以 X=0，Y=0，Z=0 XOR 0=0。t=0 时，A 和 C 变为 1，B 变为 0。C 的变化直接到达 XOR 输入，因此经过 XOR 门 20 ns 延迟后，Z 在 t=20 ns 变为 1，此时 Y 仍为 0。B 的变化先经过反相器，所以 X 在 t=20 ns 变为 1；此时 A 已经为 1，因此 AND 门输出 Y 再经过 20 ns，在 t=40 ns 变为 1。Y 的变化再经过 XOR 门 20 ns 延迟，使 Z 在 t=60 ns 变回 0，因为此后 Y=1 且 C=1，XOR 输出为 0。因此 Z 从 t=20 ns 到 t=60 ns 为 1，持续时间为 60-20=40 ns。

method.method_draft: First evaluate the expression before and after the input flip. Initially A·NOT B = 0·0 = 0 and C=0, so Z=0. Finally A·NOT B = 1·1 = 1 and C=1, so Z=0 again; any Z=1 must be a transient due to different path delays. The C branch has only the final XOR delay, so the C transition causes Z to go high at 20 ns. The upper branch cannot make A·NOT B become 1 until the slower B path passes through the inverter and then the AND: 20 ns + 20 ns = 40 ns at the XOR input; after the XOR’s own 20 ns delay, this transition drives Z low at 60 ns. The pulse duration is therefore 60 - 20 = 40 ns.
